note: How Checklings grow. dayXp is paid for every official check-in Check-In reports, to the trainer's battle partner at the time. levelCost is the XP each level costs, up to that level. Steady attendance reaches level 15 near 28 check-ins, level 30 near the end of first semester and level 50 near the end of the year. Battle XP goes to the Checkling that battled and stops at dailyBattleXpCap each day. The cap sits below one check-in on purpose: showing up always beats a full day of battling. Caught Checklings grow through battles, or through check-ins once they are the battle partner. Visitors without a bus ticket never earn or keep anything.

ranks.note: Weekly rank points per class hour. Only battles between two trainers who rode the bus count. pairLimit is how many results against the same classmate count each day. The board shows the top places plus your own.
